name: Atlas
install: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" && export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH" && (command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo ln -sf "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun && sudo ln -sf "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bunx" /usr/local/bin/bunx || true) && bun install
start: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace; if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:4310/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; nohup bun run apps/server/src/index.ts > /tmp/atlas-server.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:4310/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo 'Atlas API failed to become healthy' >&2; exit 1

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && cd /workspace && bun run dev:web
